3059.title: Embedded desktop browser does not inherit sign-in state
3059.rootCauseOneLine: The app routes links into a dedicated Electron partition without transferring external sign-in state or sanitizing the session user agent.
3059.proposedFix: Sanitize the session user agent, then make an explicit security and product decision between system-browser routing and a consented, allowlisted sign-in-state handoff.
3059.caveats: Specific third-party login pages were not opened; the dedicated partition, absent cookie transfer, and absent user-agent hardening were verified directly at the trusted base commit.
